versions.content: The Dem shall determine the queue size depending on the num- ber of events that can be reported before Dem_Init , i.e., those events with unde- fined DemReportBehavior or DemReportBehavior = REPORT_BEFORE_INIT . In case DemBswErrorBufferSize is configured, it overwrites the calculated size of the queue.
